exposure: cesarean section before the second stage of labor
Mode of delivery in the first pregnancy (vaginal delivery, cesarean section before the second stage of labor, cesarean section during the second stage of labor)
cohort: Women with two consecutive births at Toulouse University Hospital
finding: A history of term second stage of labor cesarean section was independently associated with an increased risk of spontaneous preterm birth and preterm rupture of membranes in the subsequent pregnancy.
mod_finding: Women who had a second stage of labor cesarean section had a 2.4 times higher risk of spontaneous preterm birth in their subsequent pregnancy.
gest_age: ≥37 weeks for the first pregnancy, subsequent pregnancy conducted after 16 weeks of gestation
